newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi crown prince meets Philippines' Misuari.
newsitem.headline: Saudi crown prince meets Philippines' Misuari.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Abdullah bin Abdul-Aziz on Wednesday met the leader of a Moslem separatist movement in the Philippines, the Saudi official news agency SPA said.

Nur Misuari, chairman of the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF), briefed him "on efforts to achieve peace in southern Philippines after the MNLF signed an agreement with Philippines President Fidel Ramos," SPA said.
Ramos signed a ceasefire agreement in September with the MNLF, the country's biggest Moslem rebel group, formally ending a 24-year war for Moslem self-rule in the south that killed 125,000 people.
The pact envisages a Misuari-led Southern Philippines Council for Peace and Development as a prelude to a Moslem autonomous region covering most of the south.
The Philippines five million Moslems live in main southern island of Mindanao and neighbouring island.
Saudi Arabia hosts the Islamic holy shrines in Mecca and Medina.
